title: Aurora: Beyond Vanilla
description: Exploration, magic and adventure beyond vanilla Minecraft
body:
# **🌌 Aurora: Beyond Vanilla**

<details>
<summary></summary>

Aurora is a modpack designed to expand Minecraft without losing its essence.
Explore a world full of new structures, magic, dimensions and challenges,
maintaining a balance between content and performance.

</details>

# **🔮Main features**

<details>
<summary></summary>

- New structures and biomes to explore 
  
- Magic and progression systems
  
- More dungeons, loot and adventures
  
- Storage mods to handle hundreds of items
  
- Optimized for performance and stability

</details>

# **🔧 Featured mods**

<details>
<summary></summary>

- YUNG’s Better Structures
  
- When Dungeons Arise
  
- Ars Nouveau / Hex Casting
  
- Sophisticated Backpacks / Storage mod
  
- Optimization mods (FerriteCore, etc.)

</details>

# **⚙️ Technical details**

<details>
<summary></summary>
  
- Minecraft version: 1.20.1
  
- Loader: Fabric 
  
- Designed for singleplayer and multiplayer

</details>


# **📦 Who is this modpack for?**

✔️ Players who want more content without losing the vanilla style 

✔️ Fans of exploration and magic 

✔️ People looking for a stable and cared for experience
